about_paragraph_1: I'm Dan — I build websites for the independent businesses around Bishop Auckland and County Durham, from cafés on Newgate Street to trades working across the Dales. I've been the customer standing outside a shop checking Google for opening hours that turned out to be wrong, or a phone number that didn't connect. That's the gap I fix.
about_paragraph_2: You get plain-English advice, a site that actually loads quickly on a phone in a car park with two bars of signal, and someone local who'll pick up the phone.
about_heading: Based in Bishop Auckland, not a call centre
hero_heading: Websites that get your business found on the high street of the internet.
hero_lede: I design and build fast, easy-to-manage websites for independent shops, trades and services around Bishop Auckland — so people searching nearby find you first, not the big chains.
